- (A) "gokd will hunting" — just a typo, not humorous.  
- (B) "good wiol hunting" — another typo, not funny.  
- (C) "good will punting" — changes "hunting" to "punting," which is a real word and creates a playful twist.  
- (D) "good will hvnting" — just a misspelling, not humorous.  

The best humorous edit is (C), because "punting" is a clever substitution that keeps the phrase meaningful but changes the context in a funny way.
